THE SPLIT PLATE / RECIPE

High-Protein Pepperoni Mac Meal Prep

Three simple swaps turn boxed mac and cheese into a high-protein family dinner: a higher-protein boxed mac, whole milk for the sauce, and folded-in turkey pepperoni. Same creamy pepperoni mac everyone already wants — one pot, eight portions, two days.

YIELD8 servings
TOTAL TIME20 min
COOK METHODOne pot
EST. / SERVING~370 cal | ~25g protein

Ingredients

Ingredients

  • 3 boxes Annie's Super Mac Shells & White Cheddar (higher-protein line)
  • 1 cup Nurri whole milk (or regular whole milk)
  • 4 servings turkey pepperoni, chopped
  • Light avocado-oil spray, optional — only if your pot needs it

Allergens: dairy, wheat, gluten.

You want the comfort of boxed mac and cheese but need it to carry a real dinner for the whole family — with enough protein that it isn't a cheat meal, and enough batch to cover two nights.

Method

  1. 1.COOK THE SHELLS. Cook and drain the shells from all 3 boxes according to the package directions. Reserve the cheese packets.
  2. 2.BUILD THE CHEESE SAUCE. Whisk all three cheese packets into 1 cup whole milk until smooth. No butter — the milk and cheese powder carry the sauce.
  3. 3.FOLD IN THE SHELLS. Fold the drained shells into the cheese sauce until every shell is coated and creamy.
  4. 4.CHOP + FOLD THE PEPPERONI. Chop 4 servings of turkey pepperoni and fold it through the mac and cheese so it's evenly distributed.
  5. 5.PORTION EIGHT SERVINGS. Divide the batch into 4 full servings and 4 slightly smaller servings — enough for two family dinners across two days. Size the smaller servings to your kids' appetites.

Storage and reheating

Store: Refrigerate the portioned servings in airtight containers up to 3-4 days.

Reheat: Microwave a portion 60-90 seconds until steaming, stirring once. Add a splash of milk if it tightened up in the fridge.

Lasts: Best within 2 days across two family dinners, as filmed. Freezing is not recommended — the cheese sauce turns grainy on thaw.

Estimated nutrition

~370 cal | ~25g protein.

About 370 calories and 25g protein per full serving. That is a creator estimate for one full serving of the batch — 3 boxes Annie's Super Mac Shells & White Cheddar + 1 cup Nurri whole milk + 4 servings of turkey pepperoni, divided into 4 full and 4 smaller servings (~7.5 label servings total). Flagged estimated because boxed-mac and turkey-pepperoni labels vary by SKU — recheck the packages you buy. No butter or extra fat is included because none was used in the filmed build. Kid macros are intentionally not published: the four smaller servings were sized to the children's appetites, not a prescribed child portion.

Brands I use

Annie's
Super Mac Shells & White Cheddar (higher-protein line, ~15g protein per prepared serving on the box)
The higher-protein boxed mac that does the heavy lifting. Any boxed mac works, but this line is what keeps the full serving near 25g protein. Recheck the current label — the macros move with the box.
Nurri
Whole milk (higher-protein UHT milk)
Whisked with the cheese packets to build the sauce. Regular whole milk works and shifts the protein slightly.
Turkey pepperoni
4 servings, chopped and folded through
Keeps the dish pork-free and leaner than pork pepperoni while still tasting like pepperoni mac. Verify the label — turkey pepperoni macros vary by brand.
Chosen Foods
Avocado Oil Spray (optional)
The pot spray seen in the build. Optional — boxed shells don't need added fat to come together.
